scope: Save/load lot 9: original Save/Load bodies of PickupObject (every pickup), KeyPickup, CProjectile (the projectile family, grenades and bombs) and SeeingEye with the CInvTheEye reference, their PRECREATE_SAVEGAME and INITIALUPDATE_SAVEGAME branches and save-support declarations. The bodies are selective ports recorded in the provenance ledger; the checks, the shooter tail (departure D15), the remote-charge relisting and the trail republication are OpenBlood2 code.

references.purpose: PickupObject Save/Load field order (PickupObject.cpp:617-674), relative m_fLastTime, PostPropRead on every precreate (flag rule, m_dwFlags copy, model from m_szFile), InitialUpdate skipped on a savegame, the constructor constants and the single-player removal in PickedUp.
Member list: which fields exist and which are saved.

KeyPickup block before PickupObject's (ItemPickups.cpp:480-511), property reads only on WORLDFILE/STRINGPROP, model strings applied only when set; item pickup constructors (m_nType, m_szObjectName, m_nNameID) and the multiplayer-only respawn branch.
Unconditional AmmoPickup list insertion at initial update and the ammo constructors.
Powerup constructors; m_bRotate is never set.
Weapon pickup constructors and SetBounce(false) for drops.

CProjectile Save/Load (Projectile.cpp:830-920): 26 fields, relative m_fStartTime, the unsaved m_hFiredFrom ('Can't tell'); constructor defaults; PostPropRead and InitialUpdate skipped on a savegame; the persistent SFX_OBJECTFX trail message.
Member list, including the special members m_LastPos, m_bArmed and the spin fields.

No subclass Save/Load; constructors (shadowed m_fStartTime, bounce counts, bomb flags and delays, random spin), proximity/remote/time bomb update and touch rules, the Tesla ball and Singularity attract clocks, the flare fragment's unset colour.
Per-class members, to tell saved base fields from unsaved shadows.

SeeingEye Save/Load (SeeingEye.cpp:488-516): owner and stuck object as LoadSave references, dropped flag; Load re-links and re-attaches; m_hClient and m_fNextPingTime unsaved; precreate and initial update skipped on a savegame.
CInvTheEye Save/Load (GameInvItems.cpp:932-972): m_hSeeingObject as a LoadSave reference and SeeingEye::Init with the restore's NULL client.
The unsaved remote-bomb list and its destructor/Respawn cleanup.
